content:
The test image shows a mango leaf with white, powdery-like patches scattered across its surface. There are also some brown/necrotic areas, particularly towards the tip and edges.

Based on the visual features, "Powdery_Mildew" seems like a strong candidate due to the powdery appearance. "Sooty_Mould" could also be considered if the white patches are actually a very light grey or blackish film, which is hard to discern from the current image. "Anthracnose" typically presents as darker lesions, and "Die_Back" usually affects twigs and branches, not primarily leaves with powdery patches.

I will now view one reference image from each of the four possible classes, starting with Powdery_Mildew due to the prominent powdery appearance.
